title: Cozy Country Ranch style Nashville Get-Away
description:
This charming ranch-style home offers a cozy country feel with the convenience of city living. Located just minutes from downtown Nashville and some of the area’s most popular restaurants, music venues, and attractions, The perfect home base for relaxation AND adventure featuring comfortable furnishings, rustic accents, and thoughtful touches. Enjoy your morning coffee on the peaceful porch, unwind in the cozy living area after a day exploring, or cook a Southern-style meal in the kitchen.

The space
This rental is a conjoining unit that has a totally separate entrance and exit-Duplex style. The second rental is a loft over the garage.

You have access to our private backyard fire pit and seasonal garden.  (that is shared with us or a tenant.)

Guest access
You have access to the entire home. The entrance is around back the second doorway back, closest to the window.
